findings.title: The sort comparator returns a boolean, so topPlayers does not sort by points
findings.scenario: Take board [{player:'a',points:10},{player:'b',points:30}]. The comparator returns true or false, which become 1 or 0 and are never negative. V8's sort calls compare(b, a), gets 30<10 = false (0), and leaves the order as it was. topPlayers returns [a(10), b(30)], so the player with fewer points is listed first. For longer boards the order is effectively arbitrary, so the leaderboard does not show the top scorers.

findings.title: getDay() checks for Monday, not the first day of the month
findings.scenario: On Monday 2026-11-02 every account is billed, and the job bills again every Monday after that, about four times a month.
